title: 9G Firewall
partialText: Hello! Just a quick post to let you know that the 9th version of my nG Firewall is in development. The 9G Firewall is not yet public, so if you encounter anyone claiming otherwise, they are incorrect. Unfortunately it is necessary to post this information because someone actually hijacked the name “9G Firewall” for their own project. title: Launching My Latest WordPress Plugin: REST Pro Tools
partialText: Very excited to launch my latest WordPress plugin, REST Pro Tools. This is the premium/pro version of the free plugin hosted at WordPress.org, Disable WP REST API. The free version is very basic and does exactly what it says: disables the WP REST API, no options just activate and done.
